name: empty-uri-excluded-rejects-everything-invalid
description: An empty-IA5String uniformResourceIdentifier excluded subtree should reject every leaf with a URI SAN under the NSS-lineage convention. RFC 5280 4.2.1.10 does not normatively specify what an empty URI constraint base means.
references: Go name_constraints_test "empty URI excluded constraint rejects everything"
Go src/crypto/x509/constraints.go uriConstraints (delegates host part to dnsConstraints.all)
notes: Go: dnsConstraints.all short-circuits the host-part match; with the excluded set the verdict flips to 'excluded'. Rejects the chain.
GnuTLS: rejects via its URI constraint handling.

OpenSSL: nc_uri has no empty-base short-circuit (the 'Empty matches everything' line is only in nc_dns). With an empty excluded URI base, no real URI matches, so OpenSSL accepts the chain - the only validator we test that diverges here.
